meta.source: apps/desktop/src/app.css (design system v2) plus the v3 tokens for workflows, projects, workforce, the command center and the marketplace

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The window. Every screen sits on it; the sidebar and cards stack above.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards, the toolbar, inputs when focused.

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: The sidebar, card headers, wells and the resting input background.

tokens.name: elevated
tokens.usage: What floats: dialogs, menus, toasts, the command palette, drawers.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hovered rows and buttons, skeleton base, track of a bar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The 1px frame of cards, fields and dividers between regions.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered borders, scrollbar thumbs, the edges of workflow canvases.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: The hairline between rows inside a card. Softer than line, which frames the card.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: All body text and titles, on bg, panel, panel-2 and elevated. Contrast 12:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, hints, metadata. Passes 4.5:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Icons, placeholders and decorative counts only. 3:1, never text people must read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: ZORIX violet. Selection, links, focus, and the one solid primary action of a screen. Text on it is accent-fg.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: The cyan end of the brand gradient, workflow triggers and the second chart series. Never a second primary button.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid accent fill. Dark in the dark theme, because the dark accent is light.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: The tint behind an active item: the current sidebar entry, a subtle button, an accent badge. Text on it is accent.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: Selected rows, text selection and the pressed state of a subtle button.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Completed, connected, saved, approved. Always next to a word or a check icon.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Waiting for a person: approvals, review, a budget near its limit.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Failed, refused, destructive actions. Errors also carry role=alert and an icon.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Running, starting, neutral notices and the logic nodes of a workflow.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Light that falls on the top edge of a raised surface (secondary buttons, raised tiles).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: The toolbar and the command palette only, with an 18px blur. Falls back to panel without blur.

tokens.name: glass-line
tokens.usage: The border of a glass surface.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: v3 · First chart series in the Command Center: the thing the chart is about (cost, runs).

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: v3 · Second chart series, usually the comparison (last period, another provider).

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: v3 · Third chart series. Differs from series-1 and -2 in lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: v3 · Fourth chart series.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: v3 · Fifth chart series. More than five series: group the rest as Other in faint.

tokens.name: node-trigger
tokens.usage: v3 · Workflow nodes that start a workflow: schedule, webhook, event, manual.

tokens.name: node-agent
tokens.usage: v3 · Workflow nodes that run an agent or a team.

tokens.name: node-logic
tokens.usage: v3 · Conditions, branches, loops and joins.

tokens.name: node-approval
tokens.usage: v3 · Steps that wait for a person.

tokens.name: node-action
tokens.usage: v3 · Tool and integration calls: post to Slack, open an issue, write a file.

tokens.name: priority-urgent
tokens.usage: v3 · Task priority P0. Always shown with the word and a filled flag.

tokens.name: priority-high
tokens.usage: v3 · Task priority P1.

tokens.name: priority-normal
tokens.usage: v3 · Task priority P2, the default.

tokens.name: priority-low
tokens.usage: v3 · Task priority P3.

families.sans: "Inter Variable", Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono Variable", "JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: text-4xl. The one hero number or title of a Command Center board.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: text-2xl. Section titles and big Stat values.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: text-lg. Card titles that lead a screen, the app name in the toolbar.

styles.name: emphasis
styles.usage: text-md. Row titles, large button labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Describe an activity and ZORIX runs it under your rules, with every step recorded.
styles.usage: text-base. All running text. leading-relaxed for paragraphs.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: text-sm. Small buttons, chips, tabs, field hints.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: text-xs. Metadata under a title, badges.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: text-2xs, uppercase. Sidebar group labels and table headers.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Ids, paths, keys, model names, SQL. Ligatures off.

styles.name: mono-figure
styles.usage: Counts, costs and durations in rows; tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a dot and its word.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside chips.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row, between badges.

tokens.name: space-2-5
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of small buttons, list row gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of rows and callouts.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card body padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of dialogs and drawers.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter beside the sidebar.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Kbd keys, tiny markers.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs in lists, the inner tile of a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, the logo tile, workflow ports.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Callouts, menus, workflow nodes, task cards.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs (radius-card).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, dots, avatars.

tokens.name: sh-1
tokens.usage: Rows and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: sh-2
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, workflow nodes.

tokens.name: sh-3
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: sh-card
tokens.usage: The resting card (shadow-card).

tokens.name: sh-pop
tokens.usage: Toasts and popovers (shadow-pop).

tokens.name: sh-raised
tokens.usage: Raised tiles: the logo tile, stat tiles, the selected segment.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The soft focus ring of fields, with a 1px accent border.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Buttons, switches, tabs.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers, toasts. Nothing in the interface takes longer.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that moves, by default.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Things that appear: toasts, a new node on a canvas, a new task card.
